name: Liseberg Grand Curiosa Hotel
description: Sweden's most imaginative family hotel, opened in 2023 right next to Liseberg. The star-shaped, nine-storey building has 457 rooms, all sleeping at least five guests, and is filled with whimsical details — a slide connecting the second floor straight to the lobby, a 100-year-old pony carousel spinning inside one of its three restaurants, and playrooms, puzzles and a dedicated children's cinema throughout. Rooms include a treasure-hunt activity and guests can access the park after regular closing hours. The rooftop Mei Rose bar offers Asian-inspired cocktails with sweeping views over the entire park.

rooms.name: Curiosa Family Room
rooms.description: Themed family room sleeping at least 5 guests, with a treasure-hunt activity and breakfast buffet included.

rooms.name: Curiosa Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger themed room with enhanced decor and priority proximity to the park entrance.

name: Hotell Liseberg Heden
description: Liseberg's original official hotel, located just a 2-minute walk from the park gate. A modern, family-friendly hotel offering comfortable rooms, a Swedish breakfast buffet and — with most rates — complimentary park entry included. The most convenient and consistently well-reviewed budget-to-mid-range option for a Liseberg stay.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable modern room with free WiFi and breakfast buffet, 2 minutes from the park gate.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Larger room with additional bedding for families, near-instant park access.

name: Gothia Towers & Upper House
description: A landmark three-tower hotel complex directly across from Liseberg in the heart of Gothenburg's event district, home to over 1,200 rooms, the exclusive Upper House hotel, the city's highest-located spa, and multiple acclaimed restaurants including Heaven 23 on the 23rd floor. A premium option for guests who want a full city hotel experience alongside their Liseberg visit, with the park itself just a short walk away.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable city-view room with access to the hotel spa and multiple on-site restaurants.

rooms.name: Upper House Room
rooms.description: Premium room in the Upper House tower with panoramic Gothenburg views.
